# unifi_official_device (Data Source)

Fetches a single adopted device by id via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Named distinctly from the internal `unifi_device` data source. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch a single adopted device by its UUID (Official API).
data "unifi_official_device" "gateway" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the adopted device to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `adopted_at` (String) When the device was adopted, in RFC 3339 format.
- `configuration_id` (String) The device configuration id.
- `firmware_updatable` (Boolean) Whether a firmware update is available for the device.
- `firmware_version` (String) The device firmware version, if known.
- `ip_address` (String) The device IP address.
- `json` (String) The full device details, including nested features, interfaces and uplink, serialized as a JSON string.
- `mac_address` (String) The device MAC address.
- `model` (String) The device model.
- `name` (String) The device name.
- `provisioned_at` (String) When the device was last provisioned, in RFC 3339 format.
- `state` (String) The device state (e.g. `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `UPDATING`).
- `supported` (Boolean) Whether the device is supported by the controller.
